title: Piercing Frame Duo #042 (가슴 컷 · [일반·P50 정의형·공예(Cubist-fragmented pattern)·메이크업 만바] ; [맥시·P50 정의형·스테인드글라스·체형 powerlifter bombshell])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, bust shot. TWO women standing side by side, each facing the camera straight on, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible, framed from the very top of their heads to just below their chests, the frame cutting off beneath the chests. Every face sits large and sharp in the upper half of the frame, and every woman's ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a fierce, playful expression, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick antique-brass septum ring with a smaller antique-brass ring above it and two antique-brass rings through each nostril; a straight antique-brass bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three thick antique-brass bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; a antique-brass Medusa stud above the lips; a big antique-brass hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a antique-brass labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small antique-brass studs along each jaw; a curved row of small antique-brass studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized antique-brass hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine antique-brass chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings.
#1 Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in one traditional pattern: Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with angular fragment planes filling the space between bands, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame, the pattern reading as one continuous second skin, nowhere left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere.

#2: A striking adult woman — THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a bold, commanding expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick silver septum ring with a smaller silver ring above it and two silver rings through each nostril; a straight silver bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three thick silver bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; a silver Medusa stud above the lips; a big silver hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a silver labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small silver studs along each jaw; a curved row of small silver studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized silver hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine silver chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings.
#2 Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with one material instead of ordinary skin: solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame, nowhere left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Pose: each woman faces the camera, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level. Generous spacing so every face reads clearly.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
